words.example: The shuttle's late running may push the afternoon visit back.
words.exampleZh: 班车晚点延误，可能会把下午的走访往后推。

words.example: I am running late for the huddle.
I am stuck in another meeting.
She is double-booked from three, so offer the vendor another time.
words.exampleZh: 她从三点起就时间冲突了，请给供应商另约一个时间。

words.example: The ID token is missing the ward claim, so the app cannot tell which unit she works on.
words.exampleZh: 身份令牌里没有病区声明，应用分不清她在哪个科室。

words.example: The JWT (JSON Web Token) from the bedside app failed signature checks on the gateway.
words.exampleZh: 床旁应用发出的 JWT（JSON令牌）在网关上没通过签名校验。

words.example: Do not paste a bearer token into chat; anyone who copies it can call the API.
words.exampleZh: 不要把持有者令牌贴到聊天里，谁复制走都能调接口。

words.example: The API gateway rejected the lab call because the client certificate was absent.
words.exampleZh: 接口网关拒绝了检验调用，因为请求里没有客户端证书。

words.example: Rate limiting slowed the results feed after the lab sent a burst of repeats.
words.exampleZh: 检验端突然大量重发之后，限流控制把结果推送拖慢了。
